Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a phase-transition electrolyte that, unlike anti-freezing strategies, retains high ionic conductivity after solidification via an interconnected ice framework with continuous liquid pathways. This enables 1.870 mS cm⁻¹ at −60 °C and record 430,000-cycle Zn||I₂ battery life at −40 °C, shifting the paradigm from preventing freezing to sustaining ion transport in the solid state.
